integrity: The new order-density and non-super-order-density statements are proved directly from the explicit canonical embedding and coordinate order. The source's completion and \(\sigma\)-Lebesgue assertions were checked in the full text; no computational experiment is used as proof.
limitations: The statement is specific to the Section 2 completion model. It does not assert that super order density is sufficient for \(\sigma\)-Lebesgue preservation in arbitrary nonmetrizable completions, and an equivalent older formulation under sequential order-density terminology remains a literature risk.
title: Order density does not protect the \(\sigma\)-Lebesgue property under completion
